author: fern
description:
Taking care of your health just got easier, thanks to our sponsor Zocdoc.
Start here: https://zocdoc.com/fern (ad)

Join our newsletter: https://roots.watchfern.com/

El Mencho may be the most powerful and ruthless drug lord in the world. His cartel has taken on the Mexican state and built a global criminal empire. How did he become so powerful? Why has no one been able to stop him? And what happens if he is finally caught?

Much of this video is based on the book “CJNG: A Quick Guide to Mexico's Deadliest Cartel” by Chris Dalby.
